cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(widget_producer LANGUAGES C)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

add_library(gadget SHARED gadget.c)
target_compile_definitions(gadget PRIVATE GADGET_BUILD)
target_include_directories(gadget PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

add_library(widget SHARED widget.c)
target_compile_definitions(widget PRIVATE WIDGET_BUILD)
target_include_directories(widget PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

install(TARGETS gadget
	RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR} COMPONENT gadget
	LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} COMPONENT gadget
	ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} COMPONENT gadget)
install(FILES gadget.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR} COMPONENT gadget)

install(TARGETS widget
	RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR} COMPONENT widget
	LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} COMPONENT widget
	ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} COMPONENT widget)
install(FILES widget.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR} COMPONENT widget)
